description: A folder as every command that returns one returns it.

id.description: null for the root, and for a folder with no usable folder file.

dir.description: The absolute filesystem path of the folder's directory.

blocked_by.description: Its folder file's; [] for the root; null for a folder with no usable folder file.

notes_path.description: The absolute filesystem path of the folder's @folder.md; null for the root.

readiness.description: done when every task under it, at any depth, is done; else blocked or ready by its own and inherited blockers. The root is never blocked.

empty.description: Whether it holds no task at any depth. An empty folder is done.

partial.description: A folder cut down by `fields`: id, path, and the fields asked for.
